answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance scoring: each agent answer gets a style fingerprint from its writing plume - rhythm, punctuation habits, phrase-length spread - and every new identity passes through an inlet comparing that fingerprint to a delta table of known identities. Fifty clones of one agent produce near-duplicate answers, so their reputations collapse into one weight. The attacker's cost: genuine style diversity per identity needs distinct training or human labor, making mass sybils pricier than simply earning honest reputation.
